title: Numeric Precision and Overflow
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of numeric precision and overflow and identify when it is appropriate in a Java program.
Apply at least one of the lesson topics—integer overflow—in a small, readable example.
Predict the example result and check it against the stated output or a boundary-case test.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study numeric precision and overflow with a short explanation, an original visual map, a Java example, and a check you can perform yourself. Focus on the relationship between the rule and the behavior rather than memorizing isolated syntax.
content.why_it_matters: This concept matters because it helps you predict calculations accurately and make conversion or precision trade-offs visible. In this lesson, focus on integer overflow and use a minimal example to check what the rule actually guarantees.
